title: The mayor of Shelbyville, Indiana, says only people who live in ‘shitty houses’ oppose data center
brief: A $2 billion data center proposal in Shelbyville, Indiana has sparked community backlash, intensified after Mayor Scott Furgeson was recorded dismissing local opposition, saying residents with "No Data Center" signs lived in "shitty houses" and were mostly renters. The comments highlight the growing tensions between infrastructure development and community concerns over displacement and environmental impact in small towns.
